name: Noir Editorial
pitch: A warm-black catalogue page where one bone numeral holds the room.
tradeoff: Quiet margins and a single numeral leave less room for comparing every series at once.
fontWhy: Fraunces softens the catalogue numerals, Geist keeps the interface quiet, and Fragment Mono holds the figures still.
logoIdea: A geometric R whose leg keeps going, the run leaving one trace.
sliderIdea: A full-width hairline with two calipers, the dates set as an italic chapter.
signatureMotion: Numerals roll and settle while a model colour floods the hero figure.
